senses.definition: A small cavern or hollow place in the side of a hill, or among rocks; especially, a cave used by a wild animal for shelter or concealment.
examples: Daniel was put into the lions’ den.
synonyms: Wiktionary appendix of animal terms, including their homes

senses.definition: A squalid or wretched place; a haunt.
examples: an opium den; a gambling den

quotes.text:
Lying in a den in Bombay
With a slack jaw and not much to say
quotes.reference: 1980, Colin Hay, Ron Strykert, “Down Under”, performed by Men at Work:

senses.definition: A comfortable room not used for formal entertaining.
examples: Near-synonyms: family room, sunroom, Florida room, Arizona room, rec room, playroom

senses.definition: Synonym of fort (“structure improvised from furniture, etc. for playing games.”).
examples: Our little girls love using bedsheets and other stuff around the house to make dens in the living room and pretending they're on adventures.

senses.definition: (UK, Scotland, obsolete) A narrow glen; a ravine; a dell.

quotes.text: I have made several visits of late to the Den of Rubislaw
quotes.reference: 1806, Sir William Forbes, An Account of the Life and Writings of James Beattie, LL.D., including many of his Original Letters:

senses.definition: A group of Cub Scouts of the same age who work on projects together.
(reflexive) To ensconce or hide oneself in (or as in) a den.
(intransitive, zoology) Of an animal, to use as a den; to take up residence in.

quotes.text: Although present in virtually all habitats, it preferred to den in caves, so its distribution, especially in cold, northern areas, may have been limited to limestone and other rocky regions where caves form.
quotes.reference: 2018, Tim Flannery, Europe: A Natural History, page 203:

quotes.text: “Denning” – behaviour around making dens – has changed and bears are swimming long distances, but, says Aars, there is still enough sea ice in the spring for the bears to hunt successfully.
quotes.reference: 2023 August 30, Patrick Greenfield, “Why it may be time to stop using the polar bear as a symbol of the climate crisis”, in The Guardian, →ISSN:

senses.definition: Abbreviation of denier (a unit of weight).
(Northumbria, chiefly in place names) Alternative form of dene.
Pronunciation spelling of then, representing AAVE, Bermuda English.
